concerns.text: The plan reports a VIF of 33 for the covariates (age, sex, mean FD) but proceeds with the OLS model unchanged. A VIF ≥ 5 violates SC‑005 and indicates severe multicollinearity, which can inflate standard errors and render the entropy coefficient unreliable. The methodology should either remove/recode collinear predictors, combine them, or adopt a regularized regression approach before drawing any inference.

Power is assessed only post‑hoc (FTestPower) after the analysis, without an a priori sample‑size justification. Relying on post‑hoc power does not guarantee that the 200‑subject cohort can detect the hypothesized effect (f² = 0.05). The plan should include an a priori power calculation to confirm that the chosen N provides ≥ 0.80 power, or adjust the sample size accordingly.
